root_cause: The first regression compared historical UNIT_START bound to FRESH_U4/RAW_00 against FINAL_FULL_POINT instead. Those two independently verified U4 packets have identical rho but slightly different continuous coordinates.
resolution: Compare historical UNIT_START against its SHA-frozen actual FRESH_U4/RAW_00 authority; keep all N1/N2/N3 initial centers at the identical FULL-verified FINAL_FULL_POINT SHA.
